info.title: Cindertrace API
info.description: Standalone security cases, evidence, investigation, and exact-plan response approvals. Ingestion requires source-bound HMAC headers. Agent credentials never approve containment.

browserCookie.name: cindertrace_session
browserCookie.description: Native API-owned local browser session; server checks durable revocation and exact Origin for mutations.

collectorSignature.name: x-security-signature
collectorSignature.description: HMAC over collector ID, timestamp, nonce and exact body; all four x-security-* headers are required.

parameters.name: entityType
parameters.description: Entity type; required together with entity.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity value, normalized like ingested entities. For agent: actor:<actorId>, agent-ref:<nodeId>~<profile> or magnus-node:<nodeId>. Required together with entityType.

get.summary: HiveEvent v1 feed for the HiveXUI inbox: case and containment events from the last 14 days, oldest first by (occurredAt, id); same authentication and roles as case reads

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's nextCursor; the page holds events strictly after it.

200.description: Feed page; nextCursor is null when caught up
